1: # Tasks: 2026-07-06-notebooks-flatten-refactor-and-wire-bi-ep
2: 
3: > Parent change: [proposal.md](./proposal.md)
4: 
5: ## Phase 1 — Fix the 6 dev_env notebook imports (15 min)
6: 
7: For each of the 6 notebooks under the new `notebooks/01_dev_env/`:
8: 
9: - [ ] 1.1 Edit `notebooks/01_dev_env/01_ccc_search.py` — replace the
10:       `_tool_path = Path("cianfhoghlaim/agents/adk/tools/dev_env.py")`
11:       boilerplate (lines 79-82) with the absolute-path variant:
12:       ```python
13:       _HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
14:       _TOOL = _HERE.parents[2] / "agents" / "adk" / "tools" / "dev_env.py"
15:       _spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("dev_env", _TOOL)
16:       _mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
17:       _spec.loader.exec_module(_mod)
18:       ```
19:       The `parents[2]` hops = `01_dev_env` → `notebooks` → `cianfhoghlaim`
20:       → `agents/adk/tools/dev_env.py`.
21: - [ ] 1.2 Apply the same fix to `02_drift_detect.py` (line 76),
22:       `03_firecrawl_refactor_discover.py` (line 87),
23:       `04_hf_best_model.py` (line 83),
24:       `05_openspec_list.py` (line 76),
25:       `06_mise_lint_skills.py` (line 74).
26: - [ ] 1.3 Verify with: `git grep 'Path("cianfhoghlaim/agents/adk/tools/dev_env.py")'
27:       cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/01_dev_env/` returns 0 hits.
28: - [ ] 1.4 Smoke-test: `cd /tmp && uv run notebooks/01_dev_env/01_ccc_search.py
29:       --query "Dagster asset"` succeeds (cwd-independent).
30: 
31: ## Phase 2 — Flatten notebooks/ into 10 functional groups (60 min)
32: 
33: Apply the move map from the proposal.md. For each row:
34: 
35: - [ ] 2.1 `git mv` the source to the target destination.
36: - [ ] 2.2 Open the moved file and re-anchor any
37:       `Path(__file__).resolve().parent` / `parents[N]` references
38:       that depended on the old location. For most notebooks
39:       these references are not present (they use `os.environ` or
40:       hardcoded paths); for `01_dev_env/0X_*.py` (Phase 1) and
41:       `nb_utils.py` (Phase 6), the re-anchor is mandatory.
42: - [ ] 2.3 Verify the new file imports cleanly:
43:       `python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('<new-path>').read())"`.
44: - [ ] 2.4 For the 9 speedrun notebooks, the move is
45:       `notebooks/speedrun/notebooks/speedrun/0X_*.py` →
46:       `notebooks/11_speedrun/0X_*.py` (3-level nesting → 1-level).
47:       All 9 files inherit the same flat-numbered layout + CLI guard
48:       pattern as the BIEP notebooks, but they remain a separate
49:       functional group (SpeedRunEthereum Web3/Solidity tutorials).
50: - [ ] 2.5 Repeat for the remaining Phase-2 mapping-table rows (the
51:       `legacy/` moves: the 8 leaving_cert_teacher_view notebooks and
52:       the 5 Gemini-6 corpus overviews).
53: 
54: ## Phase 3 — Delete the 6 subject_full_pipeline stubs (5 min)
55: 
56: - [ ] 3.1 `git rm notebooks/dashboards/education/{applied_mathematics,biology,business,chemistry,computer_science,french}_full_pipeline.py`
57: - [ ] 3.2 Verify: `find cianfhoghlaim/notebooks -name "*_full_pipeline.py"
58:       -not -path "*/legacy/*"` returns 1 hit (only the parameterised one).
59: - [ ] 3.3 Create `notebooks/04_biep_motherduck/07_subject_full_pipeline.py`
60:       — the parameterised version. Default subjects `["chemistry", "biology"]`,
61:       CLI flags `--subject <name>` `--level higher|ordinary|foundation`
62:       `--year <YYYY>` `--language en|ga`. Runs the 6-step BIEP pipeline
63:       (DLT → BAML ExtractCurriculumSyllabus → BAML ExtractExamPaperLayout →
64:       BAML ExtractMarkingSchemeGuideline → CocoIndex v1 App →
65:       Cognee cognify) per subject. Uses `nb_utils.connect_biep_lakehouse()`
66:       and `nb_utils.cl_argument_parser()`.
67: 
68: ## Phase 4 — Add 4 new BIEP-aligned notebooks (60 min)
69: 
70: - [ ] 4.1 Create `notebooks/02_vision_models/01_vlm_dispatch.py` —
71:       live explorer for `select_ocr_backend()`. Walks the 6 subjects ×
72:       {en, ga} leaving_certificate/ corpus (12 dirs), shows the routing
73:       table (model × file × reason). CLI flags `--pdf-path`,
74:       `--page-count`. Falls back to in-memory reasoning if `meaisínfhoghlaim`
75:       is not importable.
76: - [ ] 4.2 Create `notebooks/06_observability/03_cognee_knowledge_graph.py`
77:       — visualises the cognify pass output per subject. Tries to read
78:       from `md:oideachais.cognee.<subject>_kg` (the table that the
79:       `lc5_<subject>_cognified` Dagster asset materialises); if
80:       empty, renders a 20-node synthetic KG (5 NCCA Key Competencies
81:       + 15 example LO nodes) so the dashboard renders offline.
82:       Uses `mo.ui.altair_chart` (no additional deps beyond altair).
83: - [ ] 4.3 Create `notebooks/07_educational_stages/07_analysis_plan_viewer.py`
84:       — tabbed viewer for the 5 `analysis_plan/*.md` files (Aistear,
85:       Primary, Junior Cycle, Senior Cycle, Tertiary). Reads the
86:       markdown, renders each in a `mo.ui.tabs` slot. CLI flag
87:       `--cycle aistear|primary|junior_cycle|senior_cycle|tertiary|all`.
88: - [ ] 4.4 Create `notebooks/02_vision_models/_vision_models_README.md`
89:       — explains the VLM dispatch contract and links to
90:       `.agents/skills/meaisinfhoghlaim-ocr-htr/SKILL.md`.
91: 
92: ## Phase 5 — Add a CLI guard to every refactored notebook (90 min)
93: 
94: For every refactored notebook under `notebooks/{01..10}_*/`:
95: 
96: - [ ] 5.1 Add the `if __name__ == "__main__"` block + `_cli_main(argv)`
97:       function (see proposal.md Phase 5.1). Use
98:       `nb_utils.cl_argument_parser()` as the base argparse.
99: - [ ] 5.2 For the 6 dev_env notebooks, add per-notebook flags:
100:       - `01_ccc_search.py`: `--query`, `--limit`
101:       - `02_drift_detect.py`: `--packages` (repeatable)
102:       - `03_firecrawl_refactor_discover.py`: `--package`, `--use-local-scrapes`
103:       - `04_hf_best_model.py`: `--task`, `--hardware`, `--benchmark`
104:       - `05_openspec_list.py`: `--quadrant`
105:       - `06_mise_lint_skills.py`: `--path`
106: - [ ] 5.3 For each refactored BIEP dashboard (04_biep_motherduck/*),
107:       add `--subject`, `--level`, `--language`, `--year`.
108: - [ ] 5.4 For each vision model notebook (02_vision_models/*), add
109:       `--pdf-path`, `--model`, `--page-count`.
110: - [ ] 5.5 For each leaving_cert subject analysis (03_leaving_cert/01..05),
111:       add `--subject`, `--year` (defaults: subject=`chemistry`, year=`2025`).
112: 
113: ## Phase 6 — Extend `nb_utils.py` (30 min)
114: 
115: - [ ] 6.1 Add `import_dev_env_tool()` — computes the absolute path to
116:       `agents/adk/tools/dev_env.py` from `__file__` (uses `parents[2]`).
117:       Returns the loaded module object. Note: this is a convenience
118:       helper; the Phase 1 fix is inline-only per the user's choice.
119: - [ ] 6.2 Add `connect_biep_lakehouse(*, use_md: bool = True) ->
120:       duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection` — the canonical MotherDuck / local-DuckDB
121:       fallback. Reads `MOTHERDUCK_ENABLED` env var; if true, connects
122:       to `md:oideachais` (with the `MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN` from Infisical);
123:       else falls back to a `:memory:` DuckDB. Wraps the 12+ duplicated
124:       try/except blocks across the BIEP dashboards.
125: - [ ] 6.3 Add `cl_argument_parser(*, description: str = "") ->
126:       argparse.ArgumentParser` — factory for the BIEP canonical flags
127:       (`--subject`, `--level`, `--language`, `--year`). Each notebook
128:       imports this and adds its own custom flags.
129: - [ ] 6.4 Add `__all__` to `nb_utils.py` (currently missing).
130: 
131: ## Phase 7 — Update `cli.py` (20 min)
132: 
133: - [ ] 7.1 Replace the hard-coded `list` subcommand (currently a 9-element
134:       tuple) with a glob walk over `notebooks/{01..10}_*/**/*.py`
135:       excluding `legacy/`, `speedrun/`, `__pycache__`.
136: - [ ] 7.2 Add `cmd_run(name, *args)` that shells out to
137:       `uv run <nb-path> <args>`.
138: - [ ] 7.3 Add `cmd_dashboard(name)` that shells out to
139:       `marimo run <nb-path>` (production deployment).
140: - [ ] 7.4 Keep the existing `edit` subcommand (still useful for
141:       local dev).
142: 
143: ## Phase 8 — Update README + nb_utils + cli docs (15 min)
144: 
145: - [ ] 8.1 Rewrite `notebooks/README.md` — describe the new 10-group
146:       layout, the numbering convention, and the dual-mode usage
147:       (`marimo edit` + CLI).
148: - [ ] 8.2 Create `notebooks/__init__.py` — re-export the 4 helpers
149:       from `nb_utils.py` so notebooks can
150:       `from cianfhoghlaim.notebooks import connect_biep_lakehouse`.
151: - [ ] 8.3 Update `notebooks/cli.py` docstring with the new
152:       10-group list and the dual-mode usage examples.
153: 
154: ## Phase 9 — Archive-time `legacy/` cleanup (run at `openspec archive` time)
155: 
156: The `legacy/` preservation window is **1 release cycle** per the user's
157: choice. At `openspec archive 2026-07-06-notebooks-flatten-refactor-and-wire-bi-ep
158: --yes` time, the archive step runs:
159: 
160: - [ ] 9.1 Verify no caller imports anything under
161:       `notebooks/legacy/`: `git grep "notebooks/legacy/" -- ':!*.md'`
162:       returns 0 hits (allow .md mentions in this proposal).
163: - [ ] 9.2 `git rm -r cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/legacy/`
164: - [ ] 9.3 Verify: `find cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/legacy -type f`
165:       returns 0 hits.
166: - [ ] 9.4 The openspec `archive` step then updates
167:       `openspec/specs/oideachais-marimo-dashboards/spec.md` to remove
168:       the legacy/ rows from the migration table in the REMOVED
169:       Requirements section.
170: 
171: ## Acceptance gates
172: 
173: - [ ] AG.1 `openspec validate 2026-07-06-notebooks-flatten-refactor-and-wire-bi-ep --strict`
174:       passes.
175: - [ ] AG.2 `git grep 'Path("cianfhoghlaim/agents/adk/tools/dev_env.py")' cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/`
176:       returns 0 hits.
177: - [ ] AG.3 `git grep 'from cianfhoghlaim.notebooks' cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/`
178:       returns ≥ 6 hits.
179: - [ ] AG.4 `find cianfhoghlaim/notebooks -name "*_full_pipeline.py"
180:       -not -path "*/legacy/*"` returns exactly 1 hit.
181: - [ ] AG.4b `find cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/legacy -type f | wc -l`
182:       returns ≥ 8 (the 8 leaving_cert_teacher_view files + the
183:       5 Gemini-6 corpus overviews are preserved verbatim).
184:       At archive time (Phase 9) this should return 0.
185: - [ ] AG.4c `find cianfhoghlaim/notebooks/11_speedrun -name "*.py"
186:       | wc -l` returns 9 (the 9 SpeedRunEthereum challenges).
187: - [ ] AG.5 For each of the 6 dev_env notebooks:
188:       `cd /tmp && uv run <repo>/notebooks/01_dev_env/0X_*.py --help`
189:       prints usage (cwd-independent).
190: - [ ] AG.6 `cd /tmp && uv run <repo>/notebooks/04_biep_motherduck/07_subject_full_pipeline.py
191:       --subject chemistry --level higher --year 2025` succeeds.
192: - [ ] AG.7 All 60+ refactored notebooks pass `python -c "import ast;
193:       ast.parse(open(p).read())"`.
